Change 1687 MERGED (submitted 2026-08-12 23:50:34, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1, verified directly against the Gerrit REST detail endpoint rather than on a relayed claim). All four ACs ticked. No operator apply was required: the terraform edit was comment-only, so the plan is a no-op for this ticket.

Landed: DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX 1800 -> 2400 (2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS), the pinned relationship test tightened 1.0x -> 2.0x behind a named DEFER_BOUND_REVIEW_CAP_MULTIPLE constant, and the stale 1800s cadence figure in monitoring_autodeploy.tf corrected.

CARRIED FORWARD, not closed by this ticket: the raise absorbs the four 10-130s overshoots the 2026-08-12 markers show, but does nothing for a SATURATED episode (7b4a: in_flight oscillating 2 -> 1 -> 2 without reaching 0 for 30 minutes). Against saturation a larger bound only defers the same kill. Whether the Aug-12 episodes were saturated remains unestablished -- only terminal markers were recorded, no per-episode in_flight traces. If bound-exceeded interrupts continue at 2400s, that is the confirmation that the concurrency-gauge-vs-single-review-timer mismatch is the real defect and needs a drain signal that separates 'a review is finishing' from 'the queue is refilling'.
